name: Maternal & Pregnancy Danger Signs Protocol
source: NHM ASHA Maternal Health Handbook & Danger Signs Checklist

vaginal_bleeding.reason_en: Maternal danger sign: Vaginal bleeding reported during pregnancy.
vaginal_bleeding.reason_hi: गर्भावस्था में रक्तस्राव (Vaginal Bleeding) खतरे का लक्षण है। तत्काल अस्पताल ले जाएं।
vaginal_bleeding.next_workflow: Immediate emergency referral to First Referral Unit (FRU) / CHC via 108 ambulance.

severe_headache_blurred_vision.reason_en: Maternal danger sign: Severe headache and/or blurred vision indicating suspected pre-eclampsia risk.
severe_headache_blurred_vision.reason_hi: तेज सिरदर्द अथवा धुंधला दिखाई देना गंभीर प्री-एक्लेम्पसिया का संकेत हो सकता है।
severe_headache_blurred_vision.next_workflow: Measure blood pressure, check urine albumin, and escort to nearest CHC/District Hospital.

severe_abdominal_pain.reason_en: Maternal danger sign: Persistent severe abdominal pain reported.
severe_abdominal_pain.reason_hi: पेट में असहनीय दर्द खतरे का लक्षण है।

reduced_fetal_movement.reason_en: Maternal danger sign: Reduced or absent fetal movements reported after 24 weeks.
reduced_fetal_movement.reason_hi: गर्भ में शिशु की हलचल कम होना या बंद होना खतरे की घंटी है।
reduced_fetal_movement.next_workflow: Urgent ultrasound and fetal heartbeat assessment at health facility.

swelling_with_hypertension.reason_en: Puffy face/hands swelling combined with elevated blood pressure.
swelling_with_hypertension.reason_hi: चेहरे/हाथों पर सूजन और बढ़ा हुआ रक्तचाप। उच्च जोखिम गर्भावस्था (HRP)।
swelling_with_hypertension.next_workflow: Register in High-Risk Pregnancy (HRP) tracking track and refer to MO.

high_fever.reason_en: Maternal danger sign: Persistent high grade fever.
high_fever.reason_hi: लगातार तेज बुखार संक्रमण का संकेत हो सकता है।
high_fever.next_workflow: Refer to PHC for malaria/infection evaluation and antipyretic guidance.
